objectives: Describe the legal requirements for the premises, the sign and the working hours of an office.
Name the seven registers and books of a notary and how long each one is kept.
Open, fill and close a notarial case file correctly.
Prepare documents in the format that Ordinance No. 32 requires.
List what the office must enter at once in the information system of the Notary Chamber.

cards.front: Minimum premises of a notary office?
cards.back: **Two or more functionally connected rooms** with the chancery and the official archive (Art. 13(2) ЗННД; Art. 25 Наредба № 32).

cards.front: Working hours of a notary office?
cards.back: The same as those of the **district court** (Art. 27(1) Наредба № 32).

cards.front: When does work on deeds for entry stop each day?
cards.back: At least **two hours** before the end of the reception time of the registry office (Art. 27(2) Наредба № 32).

cards.front: How long can an office close temporarily?
cards.back: Up to **25 working days a year** and up to **2 hours a day** (Art. 28 Наредба № 32).

cards.front: Name the seven registers and books of a notary.
cards.back: General register; alphabetical index; register of holographic wills and deposits; book of acts subject to entry; book of notarial wills; book of invitations, protests, protocols and copies; expense book (Art. 28а ЗННД).

cards.front: Which registers and books are kept 100 years?
cards.back: Alphabetical index, register of holographic wills and deposits, book of acts subject to entry, book of notarial wills (Art. 28а(3) ЗННД).

cards.front: How is the day closed in the registers?
cards.back: With the **signature and seal** of the notary before the first entry of the next day (Art. 5(1) Наредба № 32).

cards.front: How is an error in a register corrected?
cards.back: By a **note** signed and sealed by the notary that says exactly how the correction reads; no erasures (Art. 5(3) Наредба № 32).

cards.front: How many documents does a volume of a notarial book hold?
cards.back: **200**; numbering starts again each year (Art. 6(1) Наредба № 32).

cards.front: What goes into a notarial case file for a deed?
cards.back: The request, a copy of the signed deed, the declarations about the special requirements of the law, the proof of representation, and the accounting documents for the fees (Art. 11 Наредба № 32).

cards.front: How long are case files for deeds kept?
cards.back: **5 years**; files for wills and deposits and decisions in circumstantial verifications: **100 years** (Art. 10(5) Наредба № 32).
Round, **40 mm**; centre: name, "Район на действие", "Р. С." and the seat of the court; top: "Нотариус" and register number; bottom: "Република България" (Art. 14 Наредба № 32).

cards.front: How many copies of a draft deed that must be entered?
cards.back: At least **five** identical copies; wills: at least four (Art. 18(1) Наредба № 32).

cards.front: How many copies go to the registry office?
cards.back: **Four** identical copies, one may be only signed, plus the request in two copies with the fee proof (Art. 21(1) Наредба № 32).

cards.front: Deadline to send a notarial will to the registration judge?
Who may receive information from a notarial case file?
cards.back: Only the parties, their successors and their representatives; a non-lawyer needs an **express** power of attorney with a certified signature (Art. 28а(4) ЗННД).

quiz.question: The district court works from 9:00 to 17:00 and the registry office receives documents until 16:30. Until when may the office start work on deeds for entry?
quiz.explanation: Work on deeds for entry ends at least two hours before the end of the reception time of the registry office.

quiz.question: A clerk made a mistake in the general register yesterday. How is it corrected?
options: With a note signed and sealed by the notary that states how the correction reads
With correction fluid and a new entry
By a new line at the end of the register
quiz.explanation: Erasures are not allowed. Corrections need a note with signature and seal.

quiz.question: How many general registers may a notary keep?
quiz.explanation: Keeping more than one general register is not allowed.

quiz.question: For which request is a notarial case file NOT opened?
options: Certification of a signature on a power of attorney
quiz.explanation: Case files are opened for deeds, wills and deposits, and circumstantial verifications. A signature certification goes only into the general register.

quiz.question: For how long does the office keep the book of acts subject to entry?
quiz.explanation: The book of acts subject to entry is kept for 100 years and then goes to the State Archives.

quiz.question: What is written in the lower half of the ring of a notary's seal?
quiz.explanation: Upper half: "Нотариус" and the register number; lower half: "Република България".

quiz.question: A sale deed is prepared. How many identical copies of the draft are needed as a minimum?
quiz.explanation: Deeds subject to entry: at least five identical copies.

quiz.question: A testator deposits a holographic will. What must the notary do within three days?
options: Inform the registration judge in writing of the name of the testator
Send a copy to the heirs
Publish a notice in the State Gazette
quiz.explanation: The registration judge is informed of the name within three days.

quiz.question: Which document must the notary enter at once in the information system of the Notary Chamber?
options: An extract of a power of attorney with signature and content certified at the same time
A signature on a declaration for a school
quiz.explanation: Art. 9а, item 1 of Ordinance No. 32 requires the extract.

quiz.question: A neighbour asks for a copy of a deed in your archive "because he is curious". What do you do?
options: Refuse; information is given only to the parties, their successors and representatives
Give it if the neighbour shows an identity card
quiz.explanation: Inquiries from case files are limited to the parties, successors and representatives.

quiz.question: What may the office sign NOT contain?
quiz.explanation: The sign may show the district, address and hours, but may not be the subject of commercial advertising.

quiz.question: An office uses a computer to keep the general register. What must it do?
options: Print the data; each sheet carries the date, signature and seal and is joined to the previous one
Nothing more; the electronic file is enough
Send the file to the Notary Chamber each day
Print only at the end of the year
quiz.explanation: Electronic registers must be printed and bound sheet by sheet.
